lines.say: a lab-made copy of GnRH, the signal it sends in pulses to the pituitary
LH rises, and FSH to a lesser degree
pump pulses started sperm production in men born short of GnRH (observational studies)
lasts only minutes, so occasional injections may not do what pump pulses do
LH, FSH and testosterone or estradiol tracked in fertility care; no set checks off-label
allergic reactions, from hives and injection-site hardening to trouble breathing
repeated use may raise sex hormones and worsen hormone-dependent tumors
in a rare pituitary tumor, it may cause pituitary problems and sudden blindness
